name: @odysseus/interface
description: Runs the job queue and a small private HTTP server that serves the single-user dashboard. The only package that binds a network port.

scripts.build: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.public.json && mkdir -p dist/public/styles dist/public/fonts && cp src/public/*.html src/public/*.css dist/public/ && cp ../report/src/styles/nocturne.css dist/public/styles/nocturne.css && cp ../report/src/fonts/*.woff2 dist/public/fonts/
